title: Studio Membership – Limited or Full Access
cost_text: Limited Membership $175/month; Full Studio Access Membership $275/month
pay_text: Monthly membership fee billed on the 1st of the month; firing fees for up to 40 pieces per month included in gas kiln access
commitment: Ongoing monthly membership with two-week cancellation notice required
summary: Studio membership with access to a cone 10 gas reduction kiln. Limited members bring bisqued pieces; full members work in-studio with clay, wheels, and workstations. Bisque firings and firing fees for up to 40 monthly pieces are included.
source_quote: Access to low fire, mid-range, luster, and gas reduction firings.
evidence_sentence: Membership includes access to cone 10 gas reduction firings with fees for up to 40 pieces per month.
evidence_quote: Firing fees for up to 40 pieces per month processed through the cone 10 gas kiln.
bring: For limited members: bisqued pots. For full members: wet clay for on-site work.
